Metabolic pathway changes with the addition of Humalite

Metabolic pathway changes with the addition of Humalite. (A) Changes in glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, oxidative pentose phosphate pathway, and TCA cycle protein abundance with Humalite. (B) Changes in protein abundance associated with N metabolism and assimilation. Arrows indicate direction of protein abundance whether upregulated or downregulated. The line indicates no abundance change. Green indicates the change under “No Urea”, beige under “Half Urea”, and burgundy under “Full Urea”. Blue indicates the common name of proteins changing in abundance within our dataset
